{{Quote|Ah, you're mocking me now, so you are.''"<br />"''Yeah, maybe I am. I get less mocking with a few mugs of ''ne'tra gal'' inside me. I'm told I get sentimental and sloppy, in fact.|[[Fenn Shysa]] and [[Kal Skirata]]|<ref name="O66" />}}
'''''Ne'tra gal''''', or '''black ale''' when translated from the [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']] [[Language/Legends|language]] into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], was a traditional [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage.<ref name="TMPaC" /> ''Ne'tra gal'' earned its name from its dark, black [[Color/Legends|coloration]], and was a sticky [[Ale/Legends|ale]] with a sweet taste,<ref name="Revelation" /> unlike its bitter-tasting contemporary, [[Kri'gee/Legends|''kri'gee'']].<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref>

''Ne'tra gal'' could be found on the menus of [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] across the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], including [[Enceri cantina|one]] in the small [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Enceri]], and the ancient ''[[Oyu'baat]]'' [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcaf]] in Mandalore's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city, [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]];<ref name="O66" /> the ''Oyu'baat'' brewed its own ''ne'tra gal'' in house.<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> Though many residents of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] viewed [[Mandallian Narcolethe/Legends|Mandallian Narcolethe]] as the Mandalorians' most prominent alcoholic beverage, a large number of Mandalorians preferred ''ne'tra gal'' to the [[Mandallian Giant|Mandallian]] [[Liquor/Legends|liquor]].<ref name="TMPaC" />

==History==
{{Quote|Let's see how much black ale my replacement can put away!|[[Mandalore the Vindicated]], regarding the newest [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion]] of the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]]|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Drinks_with_Mandalore.png|thumb|left|200px|[[Mandalore the Vindicated]] drinking a mug of ''ne'tra gal'' on board [[Spirit of Vengeance|his cruiser]].]]
[[Mandalore the Vindicated]], [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|leader]] of the Mandalorian clans during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], was a notable ''ne'tra gal'' drinker. Upon the induction of new members to [[Clan Lok|his clan]], the ''Mand'alor'' would celebrate with several mugs of the black ale.<ref name="TOR" />

The veteran Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Kal Skirata]] also enjoyed ''ne'tra gal'', as did several members of [[Clan Skirata|his clan]]. When Skirata met with clan [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] [[Fenn Shysa]] at the ''Oyu'baat'' cantina in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], to discuss Mandalore's future, they did so over mugs of ''ne'tra gal''. Days later, after Shysa accepted the then vacant position of ''Mand'alor'', ''ne'tra gal'' was said to be flowing in abundance at a celebration held at the ''Oyu'baat''.<ref name="O66" /> [[Galactic Standard Calendar|Weeks]] after the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Skirata stopped into the ''Oyu'baat'' with [[Walon Vau]], enjoying [[Glass/Legends|glasses]] of ''ne'tra gal'' while debating the appearance of their old ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]'' associates, [[Dred Priest]] and [[Isabet Reau]], as members of the resurgent [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] faction.<ref name="ImpCom">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>

The [[Sheb Niktose]] cantina on [[Vlemoth Port/Legends|Vlemoth Port]], located within the Mandalorian settlement of [[Arumorut/Legends|Arumorut]], served mugs of ''ne'tra gal'' for six [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] each. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Arumorut resident [[Teroch/Legends|Teroch]] could be found on occasion at the Sheb Niktose, drinking ''ne'tra gal'' with his Mandalorian peers.<ref name="FLT" />

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], after the elderly Mandalorian [[Bardan Jusik|Gotab]] [[Psychometry/Legends|read]] a series of memories from a [[Heart of Fire|heart-of-fire]] [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstone]] belonging to the lost [[Sintas Vel]] at the ''Oyu'baat'' cantina, Vel's granddaughter [[Mirta Gev]] offered to buy the old man a glass of ''ne'tra gal'', though he cordially declined. The ''Oyu'baat''{{'s}} owner instead provided two fresh glasses of the black ale for Gev and her grandfather, [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].<ref name="Sacrifice" /> Months later, in [[41 ABY]], dozens of Mandalorians packed the ''Oyu'baat'' to drink ''ne'tra gal'' and watch the galactic [[Limmie/Legends|bolo-ball]] [[Galactic Cup of Limmie|tournament]].<ref name="Revelation" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|By the way, for the true enthusiast - Mando ''ne'tra gal'', or black ale, is not Guinness. It's a milk stout like Mackeson - sweeter, more fragrant, and 3% ABV. As the Mandos would say, ''ne'tra gal mesh'la, jat'isyc, bal - wayii - jahaal'got''; black ale looks good, tastes good, and - by golly - it does you good! For American readers of drinking age, you can buy a slightly stronger version of Mackeson in the USA.|[[Karen Traviss]]|<ref name="Mando'a">{{WebCite|url=http://www.karentraviss.com/page20/page26/index.html|text=Mando'a|author=Karen Traviss|work=[http://www.karentraviss.com Karen Traviss]|archivedate=20110925083955}}</ref>}}
''Ne'tra gal'' was first introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' article, ''[[The Mandalorians: People and Culture]]'', by [[Karen Traviss]]. It later made its first true appearance in Traviss' [[2008]] novel, ''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]'', and appeared again in it's sequel, ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''. Traviss also made use of ''ne'tra gal'' in two of her entries into the multi-[[Author/Legends|author]] novel series, ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'', entitled ''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]'' and ''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''. ''Ne'tra gal'' also appears in the [[2012]] [[BioWare]]-made [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.

While the drink originally debuted in the ''Star Wars Insider'' article as "''net'ra gal'',"<ref name="TMPaC" /> all subsequent appearances by the Mandalorian ale make use of the "''ne'tra gal''" spelling, including the ''Mando'a'' dictionary.<ref name="Mando'a" /> Created by Karen Traviss, ''ne'tra gal'' was designed as a [[:Wikipedia:Stout|milk stout]] or [[:Wikipedia:Porter (beer)|porter]].<ref name="TMPaC" /> Though several fans compared the fictional drink to real-life [[:Wikipedia:Guinness|Guinness]], on her website, Traviss herself characterizes ''ne'tra gal'' as more similar to [[:Wikipedia:Mackeson Stout|Mackeson]].<ref name="Mando'a" /> The [[Wikipedia:Southern Tier Brewing Company|Southern Tier Brewing Company]] of [[:Wikipedia:Lakewood, New York|Lakewood, New York]] produced a limited release of a beer they called Ne'tra Gal, in honor of the fictional ''Star Wars'' drink, describing it as "A [[Wikipedia:Hops|hoppy]] black ale, inspired by those served at the Oyu'baat cantina on Mandalore."<ref name="Brewers">{{WebCite|url=http://greatbrewers.com/product/southern-tier-netra-gal|text=Southern Tier Brewing Company's "Ne'tra Gal"|archivedate=20130705103502|nolive=1}}</ref>
